sources.title: qwen3.5:2b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 features the following enhancement: Unified Vision-Language Foundation: Early fusion training on multimodal tokens achieves cross-generational parity with Qwen3 and outperforms Qwen3-VL models across reasoning, coding, agents, and visual understanding benchmarks.

sources.title: Nani Qwen 3.5 2B - ethereum.org
sources.snippet: Nani Qwen 3.5 2B is a fine-tuned Qwen3.5-2B language model for crypto wallet tool calling, trained with LoRA on roughly 2,000 examples covering 103 blockchain tools. It is designed to resolve ENS names, check balances, execute swaps, and perform other wallet operations as structured tool calls, and is distributed as open GGUF weights for local inference.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-2B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-2B Balanced 2B parameter model from the Qwen3.5 series for on‑device inference. Qwen3.5 is the latest multilingual language model series from Alibaba Cloud with improved reasoning and instruction‑following capabilities over Qwen3.

sources.title: m0_66826439/qwen3.5-2b-lora — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: This model is a fine-tuned version of the Qwen 3.5 2B base model, utilizing the LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation) technique. It is hosted on the Modelers.cn platform, specifically targeting the Huawei Ascend AI ecosystem.
